title: Restoring over existing data does not duplicate or change row counts
A restore that hit "already exists" / duplicate-key errors must not report "restored successfully"
detail: reported success=true "Database restored successfully" although every table already existed (psql errors are ignored)

title: After data loss, restoring the backup brings the lost rows back (vouchers and loan_pending)
A .sql.safe backup (the format POST /backup/create writes now) can be restored by the restore function
detail: success=false Restore failed: Backup file is corrupted or invalid

title: A file name with '..\' cannot run a SQL file from outside the backup folder
Integrity check rejects a dump that was cut off after 20 MB (no completion marker)
The restore takes a safety backup of the current database before overwriting anything
detail: restoreDatabase() has no pre-restore backup step
